'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023-present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
****[[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] airstrikes kill at least 38 [[Palestinians]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://apnews.com/article/gaza-hamas-israel-ceasefire-f98461150ec7572beb8432325cbfd299 (AP)]
**[[Israeli–Lebanese conflict]]
***Israel conducts four [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] in [[Bint Jbeil]], [[Shebaa]], and [[Shaqra, Lebanon|Shaqra]], in southern [[Lebanon]] over the weekend, killing one person and injuring several others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/7/5/israeli-drone-attacks-in-southern-lebanon-kill-one-injure-several-people (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***[[Liberia]]n-flagged [[bulk carrier]] [[Magic Seas]] is attacked by the [[Houthis]] with [[Firearm|small arms fire]] and [[rocket-propelled grenade]]s in the [[Red Sea]] forcing the crew to abandon ship, according to the [[Naval co-operation and guidance for shipping|United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operation]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2573952-voor-het-eerst-in-maanden-grote-aanval-op-schip-in-rode-zee (NOS)] [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-07-06/ship-attacked-in-red-sea-near-yemen-uktmo-says/105500588 (ABC News Australia)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Boko Haram]] insurgents kill nine people and injure four others in an attack on Mallam Fatori in [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-boko-haram-attack-extremism-1781a9fce9d63155806c319409296afe (AP)]
*[[Gang war in Haiti]]
**The historic [[Hotel Oloffson]] in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]], is destroyed following an [[arson]] attack by armed gangs. [https://lequotidien509.com/lhotel-oloffson-reduit-en-cendres-un-symbole-de-port-au-prince-seffondre/ (''Le Quotidien 509'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Karachi building collapse]]
**The death toll from the collapse of a multistory building on Friday in [[Karachi]], [[Sindh]], Pakistan, rises to 27 as rescuers pull 11 more bodies from the rubble as the three-day rescue operation ends. 10 others were injured in the collapse, of which one died in hospital from their injuries. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/death-toll-rises-to-27-in-pakistan-building-collapse-as-rescue-ends/ (CTV News)]
*A truck and a commercial vehicle carrying passengers collide along the Zaria-Kano expressway in [[Kano State]], [[Nigeria]], killing 21 and injuring three. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-road-crash-kano-state-c593a9340fc75aeec11ec4af1a15c8cc (AP)]
*Five [[Turkish Armed Forces|Turkish soldiers]] are killed by [[methane gas]] exposure in a cave in northern [[Iraq]] during an operation to search for a fellow soldier's remains. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-methane-gas-cave-iraq-soldiers-aaf1594dace8367327446285892be022 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Japan–Philippines relations]]
**The ''[[Yomiuri Shimbun]]'' reports that the [[Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force|Japanese Navy]] will export six used [[Abukuma-class destroyer escort|''Abukuma''-class destroyer escort]]s to the [[Armed Forces of the Philippines]] to strengthen the [[Philippine Navy]] due to [[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea|territorial disputes]] in the [[South China Sea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/japan-export-used-destroyers-philippines-deter-china-yomiuri-reports-2025-07-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup]]
**In [[association football]], the defending champions [[Mexico national football team|Mexico]] win a record-extending 10th [[CONCACAF Gold Cup|Gold Cup]] title after defeating the [[United States men's national soccer team|United States]] 2–1 in [[2025 CONCACAF Gold Cup final|the final]] at the [[NRG Stadium]] in [[Houston]], Texas, United States. [[Edson Álvarez]] is named the tournament's best player. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250707-mexico-defeat-usa-2-1-to-retain-concacaf-gold-cup (France 24)]
